blocks.content: Success in competitive examinations depends on consistent revision, accurate conceptual clarity, and rigorous practice.

rows: Objective practice, elimination techniques, and speed
Structured answer writing, diagrams, and concise presentation

items: Always read question stems carefully for qualifiers like 'NOT correct' or 'ONLY' to avoid trap answers.
Prioritize high-weightage topics such as Constitutional Amendments, Modern History timelines, and Key Economic Indicators.
Maintain a strict time budget per section during mock tests to simulate real exam conditions.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Thorough mastery of NCERT fundamentals is crucial for building a strong base in General Studies.
Solving Previous Years' Questions (PYQs) reveals recurring high-yield themes and question patterns.
Time management and eliminating options systematically minimize the impact of negative marking.
Interlinking static syllabus topics with recent current affairs enhances answer quality and retention.
